title: Scanner adapters emit canonical observations
description:
Scanner adapters emit versioned canonical observations for personal-data projections, components, and flows.

Adapters populate only fields the scanner actually supports; they never copy labels or display names into identity. Component output carries taxonomy type/subtype, repo-local finding identity, optional resolved vendor, and all provenance. Flow output carries typed endpoints and data categories under the structured graph model.

The taxonomy becomes an adapter/output vocabulary even though production detection may retain internal names. Unknown or missing subtype is emitted as an explicit taxonomy/capability gap, never `undefined` identity.

Personal-data rules use the closed one-rule-to-one-leaf map. Raw hits remain diagnostic; mentions and repository-level data items derive from one inventory.

Blocked on canonical types, component instance/cardinality, flow disposition, and the structured graph model.
